sharingOwnerRules.description: Interaction OWD is Private (not master-detail to Account, so sharing does not follow Account automatically). Grants mutual visibility across the whole Partners branch (Partner Engagement + Partner Success and all subordinate roles) for bi-weekly partner meeting records, per DWDECI-38 / the DWDECI-18 role-hierarchy model. Scholar-facing roles are not included and stay locked out by the Private OWD.
sharingOwnerRules.label: Partners Team Mutual Visibility
